name: The Last Question
storyline:
Every suspect has a secret.

A teacher accused of grade tampering. A scientist linked to a deadly outbreak. A witness who knows more than they're willing to admit.

As an investigator, you are tasked with uncovering the truth behind a series of mysterious cases. Armed with evidence, contradictions, and your instincts, you must interrogate suspects, break through their defenses, and determine what really happened.

Some will lie. Some will manipulate. Some will confess.

The truth is never given freely. It must be earned, one question at a time.
summary:
The Last Question is a psychological interrogation game where every suspect is powered by AI.

Step into the role of a detective and question suspects in your own words. Uncover contradictions, apply pressure, build trust, and piece together evidence as you search for the truth behind each case.

Every suspect has their own personality, secrets, motivations, and breaking point. There are no predefined dialogue trees. Instead, conversations unfold dynamically based on your questioning style, the evidence you've discovered, and the psychological tactics you choose to employ.

Will you gain their confidence? Expose their lies? Or push them far enough to confess?

Featuring dozens of unique criminal cases, progression systems, skills, achievements, and community-created suspects, The Last Question challenges players to think like real investigators and uncover the truth one question at a time. Inspired by detective fiction, interrogation psychology, and modern AI technology.
